remarks: Welcome to this beautiful 1-bedroom, 1-bath corner unit, perfectly positioned to capture the beauty of mid-city living. Bathed in natural light from two expansive walls of windows facing southwest, this residence offers a most inviting atmosphere. Step inside to a spacious living and dining area, ideal for relaxing or entertaining guests. The abundance of closets throughout the unit ensures ample storage space for all your essentials, keeping your home organized and clutter-free. Located in a highly sought-after doorman building, you'll enjoy exceptional amenities, including a state-of-the-art gym, a serene green space, and a community room perfect for gatherings or quiet reflection. Additional conveniences include an on-site laundry room and garage parking available for a monthly fee. This is more than just a home-it's a lifestyle that blends comfort, convenience, and sophistication in the heart of the city. Don't miss this opportunity to make it yours!
